question: How should `/reasoning stream` be presented in the TUI: transient chat update, footer/status replacement, or only the existing Show thinking history path?
rationale: Current source shows the gap, but the issue asks for OpenAI/Grok-style overwriting and later footer/status placement, so maintainer UX intent is needed before a narrow implementation cements the wrong behavior.

options.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
options.body: Render `agent stream=thinking` as an updating temporary chat entry that clears or collapses when the final assistant answer arrives.

options.title: Footer Status Reasoning
options.body: Show the latest reasoning delta in the footer/activity status line, matching the reporter's later request but competing with existing run-state text.

options.title: History Only
options.body: Do not add live TUI stream rendering; update help/docs so users rely on `/reasoning on` plus Show thinking for visible reasoning.

recommendation.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
recommendation.body: Render `agent stream=thinking` as an updating temporary chat entry that clears or collapses when the final assistant answer arrives.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the `/reasoning` visibility feature and are the strongest available owner for choosing the TUI contract.
